_comment: CANONICAL authored brochure copy for curaos.abualruz.com. This is a PUBLIC product brochure (no PHI, no tenant data), so its copy is co-located with the public site repo here and is the deploy source of truth: scripts/build.sh resolves --content-dir to this dir on the box. A synced copy lives in the workspace mirror (ai/curaos/curaos-website/site-content/site.json) for the doc graph. The examples/site-content/site.json is a MINIMAL standalone build/test fixture only, not this copy. Every claim here is verified against the CuraOS charter (AGENTS.md) and the committed roadmap: TRUE charter restatements are kept verbatim; capability claims are framed as design intent (pre-1.0), not shipped/GA/proven-at-scale. Zero em-dashes or en-dashes (binding rule).
headline: The care platform you actually own
subhead: A generic neutral core with opt-in Health, Education, and ERP overlays. Ship small, ship independently, compose per tenant, and run it on your own infrastructure.
positioning: Self-hosted first. Event-led. Multi-tenant from one codebase. No managed-cloud lock-in.
description: CuraOS is a composable, self-hosted-first platform: a generic neutral core with opt-in vertical overlays (Health, Education, ERP). It is designed to deploy across four targets: cloud, on-prem, hybrid, and fully air-gapped. CuraOS is in active development (pre-1.0); the profiles harden along the roadmap.

pillars.title: Self-hosted first
pillars.blurb: Designed to run on your own infrastructure with no managed-cloud lock-in. Cloud, on-prem, hybrid, and air-gapped are first-class targets, not afterthoughts.

pillars.title: Generic before vertical
pillars.blurb: The neutral core comes first and stays reusable. Vertical overlays extend it through documented seams; they never fork it.

pillars.title: Event-led
pillars.blurb: Durable, versioned event contracts are the primary integration path, with sync APIs second. Services stay loosely coupled by design.

pillars.title: Multi-tenant
pillars.blurb: Built so SaaS, on-prem, and hybrid all run from one codebase, with tenant data isolation as a core boundary (PHI and PII stay in overlay schemas).

pillars.title: Builder-led
pillars.blurb: Experiences are composed through a workflow/BPM engine and an app/site builder, so behavior is configured against documented seams rather than hand-forked.

pillars.title: Composable
pillars.blurb: Services, libraries, and clients are designed to ship independently and combine per tenant and per market. Take only the pieces you need.

architecture.caption: Opt-in vertical overlays sit on top of one neutral core and depend downward on it. The dependency direction is always toward the core, never the reverse.

deployProfiles.name: Cloud SaaS
deployProfiles.blurb: Target profile: vendor-managed, per-tenant isolation, horizontal scale.

deployProfiles.name: On-prem
deployProfiles.blurb: Target profile: single tenant on your own infrastructure, with overlays opt-in.

deployProfiles.name: Hybrid
deployProfiles.blurb: Target profile: vendor control plane with your data plane, so audit and secrets stay on your infrastructure.

deployProfiles.name: Home lab / air-gap
deployProfiles.blurb: Target profile: single tenant, fully offline, designed for zero external calls. Zero-egress is already proven for the platform's own infrastructure and this site, not yet for a full product tenant.

quickstart.caption: Illustrative composition flow (not a shipped CLI yet)
lines: ok: acme composed from the neutral core plus the overlays you need

footer.note: CuraOS is a self-hosted-first, composable care platform, in active development (pre-1.0).
